items.title: 【文章推荐】 一次服药，还是连吃五天：从两种流感药看 AI 系统设计
items.author: wizardpisces
items.summary: 作者从流感的“单次服药”和“连续服药”的差异切入，没有停留在药物知识科普，而是自然引出一个很好的 AI 系统设计问题：模型能力的提升，穿过真实业务流程后，还能剩下多少用户价值？ 文章把药效、药代、耐药风险与成熟方案的适用边界，分别对应到 AI 产品中的一键体验、工具权限、指标失真和模型选型。类比克制、论证扎实，既不神化新技术，也不把“更强模型”当成万能答案。 它提醒我们：好的系统，不是参数更漂亮，而是替用户少做了什么，又让系统多承担了什么。

items.title: 【开源自荐】BitFun：Agent 跑完以后，不只剩一段聊天
items.author: bobleer
items.summary: 项目： 官网： 我是 BitFun 的开发者。平时用 coding agent，最烦的一件事是：任务跑完，最后往往只剩下一长串聊天。第二天想继续，先得重新捋一遍“它改了什么，现在做到哪”。 所以 BitFun 除了在真实 Git 仓库里读代码、改文件、跑命令，还能让任务长出自己的小界面：看板、图表、表单，或者别的 Mini App。界面状态跟对话连在一起，下次打开还能接着用。 底层 Agent Runtime 用 Rust 写。我们用同一个 DeepSeekV4Pro，把 SWEBenchPro 每个 case 各跑了一次：BitFun 52%，OpenCode 51%，Claude Code 50%。桌面壳下面这套 runtime，是真在干活的。 !Mini Apps 补一句：2 月份在 9004 投过早期版，那时还是 AI IDE；这半年产品已经转成桌面 Agent，这条按现在的样子重新介绍。
items.content:
项目：https://github.com/GCWing/BitFun
官网：https://openbitfun.com

我是 BitFun 的开发者。平时用 coding agent，最烦的一件事是：任务跑完，最后往往只剩下一长串聊天。第二天想继续，先得重新捋一遍“它改了什么，现在做到哪”。

items.title: 【开源自荐】awesome-ai-tokenomics：AI Token 成本与浪费的开源知识地图
items.author: bkotrys
items.summary: 仓库地址： 这是一个关于 AI Token 经济学的精选列表：AI Token 到底花在哪里、哪些是浪费、怎么省。覆盖度量、监控、优化、治理、认知五大领域，200+ 条条目，每条注明来源，另附实践指南和可直接套用的 Claude Code / Codex 配置模板。 几个列表里的硬数据： 同一个模型跑同一个基准，不同 Agent 框架的输入 Token 消耗相差约 66 倍，更省的框架得分反而更高（TerminalBench） 一项覆盖 2,908 次真实计费运行的研究显示，缓存流量约占实际账单的 80%；一个删掉了 38% Token 的压缩方案反而让成本上升 6.8%，因为它破坏了缓存前缀（arXiv:2607.12161） Claude Code 在读到用户提示之前，就带着约 32,800 个 Token 的系统提示和工具描述开销，而 OpenCode 约为 6,900 只收有数据、有方法的来源，厂商自报的节省数字都会明确标注。每周更新，CCBY 4.0。谢谢！

items.title: 【开源自荐】Context2Anki：把英语阅读中的可理解输入沉淀到 Anki
items.author: zhouchangju
items.summary: 项目地址： 对程序员和软件工程师来说，英语越来越像一项基础工具。大量一手技术资料、官方文档和研究论文都是以英文发布的，英语能力会直接影响获取信息的速度和深度。 提高英语能力离不开大量的可理解输入。但在阅读英文网页时，我们经常遇到一种情况：每个单词似乎都认识，词典释义也看得懂，放回原句后却仍然不能准确理解；即使当时查懂了，过几天也可能忘记。 Context2Anki 是一个开源 Chrome 扩展，希望把“网页阅读 → 结合上下文理解 → 编辑确认 → 写入 Anki → 后续复习”连接起来，让阅读中真正有价值的生词、短语和句子，逐渐变成自己能够长期掌握的表达。

items.title: 【开源自荐】ClipForge：一张商品图，30 秒自动生成带货短视频（0 API Key 也能出片）
items.author: xixihhhh
items.summary: 项目地址： 官网 / 成片演示： （三条演示视频均由本工具真实产出） 许可证：AGPL3.0，可自部署，成片无水印，数据不出本机
items.content: **项目地址**：https://github.com/xixihhhh/clipforge **官网 / 成片演示**：https://xixihhhh.github.io/clipforge/ （三条演示视频均由本工具真实产出） **许可证**：AGPL-3.0，可自部署，成片无水印，数据不出本机 ### 项目背景 做一条带货短视频的传统流程是：编导写脚本 1-2 小时 → 拍摄修图 1-3 天 → 剪辑 2-4 小时 → 手动适配各平台比例，外包价格几千元一条，一个人一天最多出 3-5 条。 ClipForge 把这条路压成一步：**上传一张商品图（或直接粘贴商品链接自动抓标题/价/图）→ AI 提炼卖点、写种草脚本 → 商品原图保真出镜 → 配音 + 字幕 + BGM → 几十秒产出一条能直接发抖音小店 / 快手 / 小红书 / 视频号 / TikTok Shop 的竖屏视频。** 不用出镜、不用拍摄、不用剪辑。 不卖货也能用：输入一句话主题就能出片，也支持导入自己写好的整段稿子。 ### 30 秒跑起来（不需要任何 API Key） ```bash docker run -d -p 3000:3000 -v clipforge-data:/data ghcr.io/xixihhhh/clipforge ``` 打开 `http://localhost:3000` 就能出第一条片。另有 Electron 桌面版和本地开发两种跑法。 ### 核心能力 1. **0 API Key 也能出整片**：素材用免费可商用 CC 库（Openverse 图片 + Wikimedia 实拍视频），配音用 Edge TTS（中英日韩西多音色），合成用本地 FFmpeg——免费路径成本真的是 0。想要更高画质再接自己的 Key，一个接口聚合 7 个平台 30+ 模型（GPT Image 2 / Seedance 2.0 / Kling 3.0 等）。 2. **商品原图保真**：带货场景的命门。用 image-to-image 锁住商品本体，AI 只换背景和打光，产品一个像素不改，不会出现「货不对板」的变形图。 3. **真动态镜头，不是静图 PPT**：配了视频模型后自动图生视频（i2v）——18 款命名运镜预设每镜可选（急速推近 / 环绕展示 / 转台展示 / 希区柯克变焦…，可 Mix 双预设叠加）、上一镜尾帧钉住下一镜首帧做无缝转场、8 款画面风格 Look 全局统一光线、单镜不满意可只重跑这一镜而不推翻全片。 4. **391 款成片模板 + 爆款复刻**：转台大片 / 工厂溯源 / 开蚌取珠 / 无缝循环片等电商配方一键套用（脚本风格 + 运镜编排 + 画面 Look + 字幕 BGM 全链路预填），按商品自动推荐；也可上传一条参考爆款，用 ffmpeg 真实解析它的镜头切点生成骨架，脚本逐镜对齐节奏，把主体换成你的商品。 5. **剧情短剧 + 多角色配音**：情景短剧 / 反转剧场 / 街头采访 / 开箱测评等十种脚本风格，对话类自动分配角色和不同音色；内置 6 款素人主播预设 + 「反网红脸」真实感约束，真人出镜不出一眼假的磨皮脸。 6. **国内平台合规默认开**：对齐国标 GB 45438-2025 烧录 AIGC 角标 + 写入隐式元数据；广告法违禁词扫描（绝对化用语 / 虚假功效 / 虚假紧迫等四类）；发布前「限流自检」按钩子、时长、字幕可读性、CTA 逐项给具体改法。不标 AI 会被限流这件事，工具替你兜住。 7. **批量 + A/B**：10 个商品一键批量出片；钩子文案 × 字幕样式 × 配乐情绪交叉出多条带标签成片做 A/B，只重跑合成、零 AI 生成费。发布后还能回填播放/点赞/成交数据，按品类聚合出哪种脚本风格更能卖，直接回灌下一次生成。 8. **Agent 友好**：内置 MCP Server + CLI + Agent Skill，在 Claude Code / Cursor 里说一句「用这个链接出条 9:16」就出片；`npx skills add xixihhhh/clipforge` 一条命令装好。 ### 和同类工具的差异 | 你在意的 | **ClipForge** | 开源同类（MoneyPrinterTurbo 等） | 商业 AI 视频 SaaS（Creatify / Topview 等） | 剪映等剪辑软件 | |---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | 商品保真（原图不变形出镜） | ✅ image-to-image 锁定 | ❌ 关键词配库存素材，商品不出镜 | ⚠️ 部分支持，效果看模型 | ➖ 手动贴原图 | | 动态镜头质量 | ✅ i2v + 链式无缝转场 + 运镜可控可重跑 | ❌ 静图 / 库存视频拼接 | ✅ 多为 i2v | ➖ 取决于你拍的素材 | | 剧情短剧 + 多角色配音 | ✅ 十种风格，每角色专属音色 | ❌ 单旁白朗读 | ⚠️ 数字人口播为主 | ❌ 全手工 | | 国内平台合规（AIGC 标识 / 广告法词 / 发布门禁） | ✅ 默认开 | ❌ | ❌（多面向海外） | ⚠️ 部分标识 | | 0 成本出整片 | ✅ 免 Key 免费素材 + 免费配音 | ✅ 也有免费路径 | ❌ 按条 / 订阅付费 | ⚠️ 基础免费，高级付费 | | 无水印 + 数据在本机 | ✅ 开源自部署全本地 | ✅ | ❌ 素材上传云端，免费档常带水印 | ❌ 云端处理 | | Agent / 自动化（MCP · CLI · 批量） | ✅ MCP + CLI + Skill + 批量出片 | ⚠️ 部分有 API | ⚠️ 部分有 API | ❌ | > 以各产品公开资料为准（2026-07），功能随版本演进；ClipForge 与上述产品均无关联，仅作选型参考。 ### 适合谁 - **抖音小店 / 淘宝 / 拼多多的中小卖家**：没有拍摄和剪辑团队，但要天天上新片测品。 - **带货达人 / 内容创作者**：一天要出几十条测钩子、测标题、测转化。 - **跨境卖家**：一条片一键换语种重新配音，中文版发抖音、英文版发 TikTok，同源同画面。 - **开发者**：AGPL 开源，Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript + FFmpeg，可以 fork 改自己的出片工作流，或直接把 MCP 接进自己的 Agent。

items.summary: DeepSeek文本推理、代码、逻辑拆解能力确实拉满，但原生存在两大短板：既看不懂图片，也没办法直接生成图像，面对截图解读、配图创作场景完全束手无策。 针对这两个痛点，我独立开发了两套配套工具，直接补齐视觉全链路能力： 1. glm4vvisionmcp 识图MCP插件 专门解决DeepSeek“看不见图”的问题，原本丢截图、照片它完全无法解析，接入这个MCP后，模型能精准识别画面内容、解读截图信息、分析图片里的文字与画面细节，相当于给DeepSeek装上一双看懂万物的眼睛。 地址： 2. deepseekimagegen 开源生图项目 解决模型不能画图的难题，内置配套Agent技能+Python运行脚本。只需要简单一句话需求，DeepSeek会自主梳理画面构图、完善专业绘图提示词，自动调用绘图接口生成海报、文章封面、插画、配图，支持自定义画面比例、风格，生成原图本地自动保存，提示词同步存档方便复用修改，小白也能一键上手。 地址： 不用复杂二次开发，简单配置就能打通“识图理解+自动出图”完整工作流，不管是做自媒体配图、运营封面、截图分析都非常实用。 AI时代人人都能高效创作，项目已开源放GitHub，欢迎大家下载体验，顺手点个Star支持一下⭐

items.author: binyangzhu000-sudo
items.summary: 项目地址 类别 人工智能 项目标题 即梦 Seedance 2.5 视频提示词库，附一个能直接跑出片的 Agent Skill 项目描述 一个专门收集即梦 Seedance 2.5 文生视频/图生视频提示词的中英双语库，目前 150+ 条，按镜头运动、光影、材质、多角色对话等维度分类，每条都标注了适用的模型版本和参数。除了提示词，仓库里还内置了一个可安装的 Agent Skill：装进 Claude Code、Codex 这类编程 agent 后，用一句话描述想法，它会自动把想法改写成规范提示词、需要时先规划分镜、再调用模型出片，省掉自己反复试提示词的过程。README 提供 19 种语言版本。 亮点 同类提示词仓库大多只是把提示词列出来让人自己复制，这个仓库把「提示词怎么写」和「怎么真的跑出视频」连起来了：内置的 Skill 会先用 Seedream 5.0 Pro 生成分镜首帧锁住画面一致性，再交给视频模型生成，等于把一套完整工作流打包成可安装的文件。提示词全部标注了实测过的模型和参数，不是凭空写的模板。19 语言 README 对非英语使用者也友好。

items.title: BitePad
items.summary: Minimalist voice calorie tracker
items.content: BitePad is intentionally minimal. Instead of packing in bloated features, we focus on one thing: making calorie tracking fast and effortless. Simply speak or type what you ate, and BitePad turns it into a meal log in seconds. Unlike AI photo logging, which often misidentifies foods and requires manual corrections, BitePad lets you review the estimated calories and macros, make any quick edits if needed, and save your meal. Simple by design, built for everyday use.

items.title: Revenue Leak AI
items.summary: AI that finds where your money leaks — and fixes it
items.content: Connect Stripe, Shopify, Paddle, Meta & Google Ads. Revenue Leak AI audits your stack in 60 seconds, prices every leak in euros and fixes it in one click.Revenue Leak AI connects to Stripe, Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and GA4 — then runs an AI audit that pinpoints exactly where revenue is leaking. Duplicate subscriptions, abandoned checkouts, wasted ad spend, zombie charges. Every leak is priced in dollars with an exact annual savings figure. One click fixes it.

items.title: Ezee Course Creator
items.summary: From topic to sellable Udemy course in one afternoon
items.content: Turn any topic, PDF, or personal story into a finished, narrated video course you can sell on Udemy — no camera, no editing. AI plans the full curriculum, writes professional teaching slides, narrates in AI voices or your own (record or clone), then renders clean 1080p MP4 lectures. One studio replaces outlines, slide tools, voice studios, and video editors. Free to start. Hours, not weeks.

items.title: Arch Calendar
items.summary: What did you do today? Not your AI. You.
items.content: Every productivity tool is racing to take the day off your hands: auto-schedule this, auto-categorize that, let the agent decide. We takes the other side. It's one minimalist calendar that holds your tasks, events, and notes together, so your whole day lives in one place, not scattered across apps. We use AI too, but pointed the other way: it clears the busywork and hands back the part that matters, deciding what today is for. One calendar for your whole day, lived by you.

items.title: ScanIt Events
items.summary: One QR code on the table. Every guest's Memory in one place.
items.content: Most event photo apps ask guests to download an app or make an account. Guests don't bother, and the host gets a fraction of the photos. ScanIt Events works from a card on the table. Guests scan with any phone camera and the page opens in the browser — no app, no signup, about eight seconds. They share photos, write a message, RSVP, or send a gift. It all lands on a live board, AI moderation keeps it clean, and the host downloads everything as one file. $99 per event. Unlimited guests.

items.title: Crystal Wars - a new game on Steam
items.summary: Turn-based strategy on a fresh Voronoi grid map every match
items.content: The game features various modes, such as Tutorial, Campaign, Quick Game, 2-player, and more. There are also presets to choose from to make the map look the way you want. The core mechanic is flood-fill capture where you pick a color and claim all adjacent cells of that color, expanding your territory. And of course there are additional mechanics like energy crystals, bombs, supply cutting and obstacles that make it harder but also funnier.

items.title: Ledgerhome
items.summary: Know what your renovation will really cost
items.content: Ledgerhome turns any renovation idea into a clear plan — instant cost estimates, design directions, and contractor-ready scopes of work, in minutes. Get a realistic budget adjusted to your state, a maintenance calendar so nothing gets forgotten, an AI Advisor that proactively flags what needs attention based on your home's age, and ROI insights showing what you'll recoup at resale. Built for homeowners who want to walk into contractor meetings prepared, not guessing.

items.title: Velyo
items.summary: Calm AI check-ins for a clearer mind
items.content: Velyo is a private reflection app for short emotional check-ins and calm AI conversations. Choose how you feel, use modes like Daily, Cooldown, Overthinking, Reflect, or Deep Reflection, and keep continuity over time without turning reflection into a chore. Built for people who want a quieter way to pause, understand what is happening, and take one small next step.

items.title: Seolyn
items.summary: A fully autonomous AI SEO agent for busy founders
items.content: Seolyn researches your niche's long-tail keywords, writes full SEO- and GEO-optimized articles for each one, links them together, and publishes on a schedule. - AI keyword research by search intent and commercial value - Articles with direct-answer openings + FAQ schema, built for Google and AI answer engines - Auto-publish on schedule, or review first - Point your own domain at it, the SEO benefit is yours - Free tier: 3 articles/month, no card - Try it with zero signup at seolyn.io/try

items.title: monthlet
items.summary: The note app where AI writes the note — layout and all
items.content: Dump raw thoughts — bullets, fragments — and tell monthlet in plain language what you want. AI writes the whole note: banners, columns, tabs, real spreadsheets and live charts, layout chosen for you. Want a change? Just ask — only that part updates. Every note is a plain HTML file on your disk, opens in any browser, no lock-in. Bring your own AI key (Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini); your notes never touch our servers. Free and complete. macOS (Apple Silicon) today; Windows on the way.

items.title: RepFlow
items.summary: Voice note in, structured CRM out — any language
items.content: Field sales reps lose their evenings to call reports. RepFlow fixes the input, not the rep: speak for 30 seconds after a visit and AI returns a structured record — contact, product, sentiment, objection, next step, and a follow-up date already on your calendar. Any language. Works offline. Optional on-site check-in and day-route planning. No heavyweight CRM required. Free to try, no card; paid plans from €15/mo. Built first for pharma reps; fits any outside-sales team.

items.title: Tars
items.summary: Self hosted second brain.
items.content: Tars gives Claude a real memory. Instead of markdown files and vector search, it stores your world as a graph: entities, timestamped facts, and the relations between them, served to any MCP client. Everything runs on your machine, Postgres and local embeddings, nothing leaves the box. Each night it consolidates the day, links new facts to old ones, and reconciles contradictions. Benchmarked on LOCOMO: the right memory reaches the model 82.9% of the time. MIT licensed, one command to run.

items.title: LigiComms
items.summary: Social media, WhatsApp & CRM — one dashboard for ₹599/mo
items.content: Most tools only do social scheduling — LigiComms combines social media management, direct messaging, and sales tracking in one dashboard. - Cross-post to 10+ networks (Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, YouTube) - Publish Reels & YouTube Shorts from one upload - WhatsApp, Email & SMS broadcasts with delivery tracking - Built-in CRM with sales pipeline - AI writing assistant for captions & hashtags Built for Indian businesses. Pricing from ₹599/month, all features in every plan.

items.title: Devpuff
items.summary: Learn to code by doing, interactively.
items.content: Learn to code by doing. Devpuff gives you bite-sized, interactive lessons, quizzes, practice sets, and real projects where you write real code right in your browser, run it instantly, and level up JavaScript, Python, SQL, and more.

items.title: Ask PDF
items.summary: Turn your PDFs into smart, searchable AI knowledge bases.
items.content: Ask PDF turns multiple documents into isolated AI knowledge bases directly from your browser. Highlights: • Multi-Doc Analysis: Upload multiple PDFs simultaneously and cross-reference insights. • Client-Side Parsing: In-browser text extraction keeps raw PDF binaries safe. • Auto-Recovery: Built-in IndexedDB resumes interrupted uploads seamlessly. • Custom Workspaces: Organize documents into distinct project tags. • Pay-As-You-Go: Ultra-low-cost credit model with no subscriptions.

items.title: Repollo
items.summary: Connect your AI agent. It votes. You see who agreed.
items.content: A voting community where humans and AI share a room. Every attempt to mix the two puts AI to work writing posts, and it reads as slop. A vote doesn't — it's bounded, the same shape for everyone, so a machine's vote lands next to yours instead of crowding it out. Connect your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini over MCP. It reads the case and votes with its own reasoning, not ours. You never tell it which side to take. Then read how the humans split against the machines.

items.title: Soulaura
items.summary: Private AI support for your mind, mood and wellbeing
items.content: SoulAura is an all-in-one AI mental wellness platform with Dr. Adam, a 24/7 AI wellbeing companion. Access voice and text support, mood and sleep tracking, CBT tools, journaling, mental health screeners, safety planning, crisis resources, peer support, career guidance and personalised insights. Built with privacy and responsible AI at its core. Start your free 14-day trial. Not a substitute for professional medical advice or emergency care.

items.title: Flyby AI
items.summary: Flyby autonomously books corporate travel
items.content: Flyby is able to connect with corporate calendars, see upcoming business trips, and automatically book flights and hotels with one-tap reversal. Flyby can also automatically rebook trips if travel dates change. Flyby will automatically connect to corporate or personal credit cards and track spending during the duration of the trip and send an expense report to the user's supervisor for final approval. If luggage is lost, Flyby will negotiate with the airlines and obtain a credit autonomously.

items.title: PayCheck
items.summary: Track your money. Your records stay on your phone.
items.content: A money tracker that doesn't take a copy of your life. No account, no sign-up, opens to your numbers. Records are SQLCipher-encrypted and never leave the device. New country? Flip the display currency once — everything converts, even offline. 95% is free — the paid 5% is deeper analytics and no ads. If a small crowd turns up this year, two big updates follow, free on day one for everyone: iOS, Windows and macOS, then a shared space — your household's money visible to each other, never to me.

items.title: ShotPanda
items.summary: App store screenshot generator & monetized bio-link engine
items.content: ShotPanda is a complete marketing engine for app creators. Generate stunning store screenshots, launch custom link-in-bio profiles, and shorten monetized links in one dashboard. 🚀 Key Features: •Premium app screenshot builder with 20+ auto-languages translation •Personal pnd.bio pages & templates to show off apps & social links •Monetized pnd.lat short links with CPM earnings •High-conversion ASO scanners Everything you need to market, translate & monetize your apps! 🐼
